main_text.p: etsi scriptura sint distinctæ, numeros tamen nullos habent. Hoc ipse non præstiti, qvia absqve errore uti apparebat, illud agere non confidebam.

Nudistertius R. P. Fr. Thomam á Novaria invisi, & ipse libellum mihi Samaritanum ostendit, preces illius gentis, ut opinor, continentem; ibiqve nonnulli erant versus, qvorum primæ dictiones incipiunt à literis Alphabeti ordine digestis, veluti Lamentationes Jeremiæ; atq; ex manifeste comprehendi, me hujusqve in Alphabeto Samaritano samec pro sade, & è contra sade pro samec, perperam usurpasse, nescio qva deceptum conjectura. Putabam enim literam samec esse, & sade; at in eo libro contrarium nempe ab una qvintum decimum in Alphabeto locum, ab altera vero decimum octavum occupari vidi, tibi significari necessarium duxi, & de eo, qvid ipse sentias me certiorem facias velim.
Idem Pater à Novaria præ manibus habet Interpretationem Grammaticæs, qvam ei tradidi, Ægyptio.Arabicæ, nec non

page.notes: Catchword-like fragment "non" at the foot right is the start of the next line's word, treated as part of the last line. Printed "Grammaticæs" appears as printed; "Interpretationem" and the Arabic/Egyptian line are as printed. Several letters are blurred near the right margin (dark scan band), notably in "decimum octavum" and "necessarium"; readings there are best effort. Printing errors left as printed: "ab una qvintum decimum" (for ab una quintum decimum), "Ægyptio.Arabicæ ," spacing.
